newcomerCriteria: Foreign minors living in Romania access compulsory schooling on the same terms as citizens
Foreigners enrolled at any level have unrestricted access to school activities
Until parents are identified, school-age unaccompanied foreign minors have access to schooling
Enrolling a foreign pupil rests on equating the study done in the country of origin
The education ministry sets the limits for recognising study in the country of origin
Dossiers equating study done abroad are received and assessed by the school inspectorates
Romanian-citizen pupils apply to a county inspectorate to have classes I-XII equated

evidence.bullet: Foreign minors living in Romania access compulsory schooling on the same terms as citizens
evidence.quote: Strainii minori care locuiesc in Romania au acces la invatamantul scolar obligatoriu in aceleasi conditii ca si minorii cetateni romani

evidence.bullet: Foreigners enrolled at any level have unrestricted access to school activities
evidence.quote: Strainii cuprinsi in invatamantul de toate gradele au acces, fara restrictii, la activitatile scolare si de instruire in societate

evidence.bullet: Until parents are identified, school-age unaccompanied foreign minors have access to schooling
evidence.quote: pana la identificarea parintilor, minorii de varsta scolara au acces la sistemul de invatamant

evidence.bullet: Enrolling a foreign pupil rests on equating the study done in the country of origin
evidence.quote: limitele si conditiile recunoasterii si echivalarii studiilor efectuate in tara de origine, pentru inscrierea elevilor straini in sistemul national de invatamant

evidence.bullet: The education ministry sets the limits for recognising study in the country of origin
evidence.quote: Ministerul Educatiei, Cercetarii si Tineretului stabileste, potrivit legii, limitele si conditiile recunoasterii si echivalarii studiilor efectuate in tara de origine

evidence.bullet: Dossiers equating study done abroad are received and assessed by the school inspectorates
evidence.quote: Metodologiei privind echivalarea de către inspectoratele școlare județene și Inspectoratul Școlar al Municipiului București a perioadelor de studii efectuate în străinătate

evidence.bullet: Romanian-citizen pupils apply to a county inspectorate to have classes I-XII equated
evidence.quote: În vederea echivalării perioadelor de studii corespunzătoare claselor I-XII, elevii trebuie să se adreseze inspectoratelor școlare județene sau Inspectoratului Școlar al Municipiului București
